scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir dist --minify
scripts.build:preview: mkdir -p dist && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env preview --outdir dist --minify
scripts.build:production: mkdir -p dist && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir dist --minify
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --env production --minify && bun run styles:publish:production
scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler deploy --env preview --minify && bun run styles:publish:preview
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler deploy --env production --minify && bun run styles:publish:production
